segments.motivation: To organize projects, track tasks, manage teams, assign responsibilities, and ensure deadlines are met.
To streamline workflows, improve productivity, ensure accountability, and manage daily operations.
To manage personal tasks, collaborate with teams, and gain visibility into project progress.

tasks.purpose: to plan, organize, and oversee work from start to finish
to monitor progress, set due dates, and mark completion
to share projects, assign tasks, and communicate within the platform
to set up rules for tasks, updates, and notifications to reduce manual effort
to generate summaries, transcribe meetings, create content, or get smart suggestions

benefits.claim: The product offers a wide range of features, acting as an 'all-in-one' solution that can replace multiple tools.
The product is highly customizable and adaptable to various team processes and organizational types.
The product helps teams work efficiently, stay organized, and meet deadlines.

frictions.claim: The product's abundance of features can be overwhelming for new users, leading to a steep learning curve.
Reviewers may experience specific UI/UX issues such as incorrect AI chat sizing, lack of an undo function, or general glitches.
Retrieving or managing older projects and subtasks can be difficult, leading to information getting lost.
